{{Short description|German chemist (1940–2017)}}
'''Gerd Becker''' (3 May 1940 – 10 January 2017) was a German chemist. 

==Biography==
Becker was born in [[Eschwege]], Germany on 3 May 1940. He held a chair of inorganic chemistry at the [[University of Stuttgart]]. In 1974 he synthesized the first localized [[Organophosphorus#Phosphorus multiple bonds|phosphaalkene]]. Becker died on 10 January 2017, at the age of 76.
